01 / THE AIRCRAFT’S ROLE

Designed around its mission.

These aircraft collect and share information. Airborne early-warning platforms combine radar coverage with communications and, on some designs, onboard coordination facilities. Other surveillance aircraft are configured for different sensing roles.

RECOGNIZABLE FEATURES

Radar fairings, antenna arrays, or sensor housings may be visible. A large radar dome is associated with some early-warning aircraft, not all surveillance designs.

02 / COMMON ROLES

Where it fits.

  • Airspace surveillance
  • Early warning
  • Communications and coordination

Military aircraft categories can overlap. Equipment and capabilities vary by model, variant, and operator.

03 / A CLOSER LOOK

Good question.

Does every surveillance aircraft have a radar dome?

No. Sensors and antennas can be arranged in many ways. The large dome shown here illustrates one early-warning configuration.
